changelog: Release notes are available in-client and in official announcements.
latest_features: AutoMapart now supports Available-Only targeting to focus pathing and placement on blocks currently present in inventory
AutoMapart targeting and build list selection now stay inventory-aware when Available-Only is enabled
Added Ghost Refresh setting to periodically recheck nearby map cells and restore missing ghost overlays
Ghost refresh flow now rehydrates pending cells from the source image when world state does not match expected mapart blocks
Auto-walk now prioritizes remaining placeable targets more reliably under mixed missing/available inventory states
